capabilities: Organize novels into projects, volumes and chapters with step-by-step writing workflow
Co-write paragraphs and sentences with AI candidates and rewrites
Manage entities (characters, places, factions, items) with consistency checks
Score chapters on six quality dimensions with issue lists
Export manuscripts to Markdown, TXT, HTML, EPUB and DOCX
disambiguation: Not a one-click auto-writer or AI chatbox; it is a human-in-the-loop pipeline (project, volume, chapter) where AI assists each step and all files stay in the vault.
extras: Desktop-only; no telemetry; API keys encrypted locally with session passphrase (unrecoverable if lost); no auto-update (release link only); bilingual UI; workers/ folder required for background tasks; legacy writing commands deprecated until v5.0.0.
problem: Obsidian has no structured, AI-assisted pipeline for long-form fiction: planning volumes and chapters, drafting with AI, tracking continuity, and reviewing chapter quality.

relations.evidence: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or a local model such as Ollama
